text: undertone 51ec388 pushed to main 10-7: Synth and Sampled echoes (makeFx echo, Far shore arpEcho) follow the tempo via tempo(bpm, time) on E('tempo') each bar; Strudel's bell echo uses the tempo's dotted eighth instead of a fixed 0.375. Verified in a page: 0.5 at 90 -> 0.375 after tempo(120).

undertone plugin cache on the Mac updated 10-7 to 0.13.0 (claude plugin marketplace update coter-kit; claude plugin update undertone@coter-kit); the 0.13.0 cache holds main at 51ec388, so an auto-started bridge now has every fix through the echo tempo. The cache is keyed by plugin version: later fixes reach it only after a version bump in .claude-plugin/plugin.json and another update.
